snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | Survive The Nest
snippet.description:
Face the evolving Orphans that stalk the decrepit remains of New Dawn, utilizing your cassette futurism-inspired arsenal to survive every brutal encounter. 
 
Coming to PC, PlayStation5 and Xbox Series X/S this fall!
